g.text: Autonomous defaults: 4.208 V, 2.048 A charge setting.

g.desc: Autonomous defaults: 4.208 V, 2.048 A charge setting.

g.text: Floating D+/D- selects 500 mA input; actual charge

g.text: current falls to match input power. ILIM: 620R (~0.57 A).

g.text: J101 receives 5 V from the GCT USB daughterboard.

g.desc: J101 receives 5 V from the GCT USB daughterboard.

g.text: J902 -> two-wire harness -> J101 (same pin numbers).

g.desc: J902 -> two-wire harness -> J101 (same pin numbers).

g.text: See USB_Input, sheet 10; qualify before charging.

g.text: J102 = PCB pigtail to the RCY/BEC cable mate.

g.desc: J102 = PCB pigtail to the RCY/BEC cable mate.

g.text: Red = protected P+; black = protected P-.

g.desc: Red = protected P+; black = protected P-.

g.text: FMA holder: 2 x 3400 mAh in parallel, 6800 mAh total.

g.desc: FMA holder: 2 x 3400 mAh in parallel, 6800 mAh total.

g.text: Verify polarity; no PCB-mounted RCY footprint is implied.

g.desc: Verify polarity; no PCB-mounted RCY footprint is implied.

g.text: D101 lights while the charger reports charging.

g.desc: D101 lights while the charger reports charging.

g.text: R107 pulls the interrupt up to the host 3.3 V rail.

g.desc: R107 pulls the interrupt up to the host 3.3 V rail.

g.text: Matching labels connect electrically. VSYS also supplies the always-on pushbutton controller.

g.desc: Matching labels connect electrically. VSYS also supplies the always-on pushbutton controller.

g.text: BQ25895 I2C address = 0x6A. If firmware writes settings, disable its watchdog before host shutdown.

g.desc: BQ25895 I2C address = 0x6A. If firmware writes settings, disable its watchdog before host shutdown.

g.text: Default settings return after complete charger power loss. Keep J104 OPEN until those settings are qualified.

g.desc: Default settings return after complete charger power loss. Keep J104 OPEN until those settings are qualified.

g.text: R101/R102 and the external 10k NTC sense temperature.

g.desc: R101/R102 and the external 10k NTC sense temperature.

g.text: Attach the NTC to the cells; connect it at J103.

g.desc: Attach the NTC to the cells; connect it at J103.

g.text: J104 OPEN = charging disabled; R105 holds Q101 off.

g.desc: J104 OPEN = charging disabled; R105 holds Q101 off.

g.text: Fit the shunt only after cell/USB/NTC validation.

g.desc: Fit the shunt only after cell/USB/NTC validation.

g.text: Armed = autonomous charging with the host ON or OFF.

g.desc: Armed = autonomous charging with the host ON or OFF.

g.text: SW101 is service wake/reset, not the front power button.

g.desc: SW101 is service wake/reset, not the front power button.

g.text: Follow the top row from USB input to charger and battery. The lower row controls and monitors charging.

g.desc: Follow the top row from USB input to charger and battery. The lower row controls and monitors charging.
